en: Sepia-toned early-20th‑century street scene showing an open-top touring car with large spoked wheels and a spare tire on the side. Several uniformed men (likely military or police officers) sit in and around the car, with one man in a long coat entering or exiting the rear seat. Onlookers, including civilians and a clergyman, stand in front of a building with large doorway and shop windows. The architecture is European, with cobblestone pavement and a commercial storefront displaying various goods.
